text: I have met with school representatives from Allenby Junior Public School, local residents and Transportation Services staff to discuss traffic safety around the school. All stakeholders agree that U-turns should be prohibited in the school zone. Transportation Services staff are aware of and supportive of the recommendations below. I am therefore requesting that the Members of North York Community Council support the recommendation to implement U-turn movement prohibitions on St Clements Avenue and Castlefield Avenue, for the immediate blocks fronting Allenby Junior Public School.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on St. Clements Avenue, between Castlewood Road and Avenue Road. 2. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Castlefield Avenue, between Castlewood Road and Avenue Road.
